# KTX2 regression fixture

`rib-normal.ktx2` is a shortened local copy of `Rib_N.ktx2` from the
[Khronos glTF Sample Assets CarConcept model](https://github.com/KhronosGroup/glTF-Sample-Assets/tree/main/Models/CarConcept/glTF-KTX-BasisU-Draco).
